schema.title: TPNET_Protocol_Input_Schema
schema.description: A single TP-NET protocol message for a VIDA device. The per-type rules on which 'command' values are allowed are described in the system prompt and must be respected by the model.

command.description: TP-NET command keyword (second token). Must be valid for the chosen 'type' according to the system prompt.

params.description: Ordered list of parameter tokens for the command, as strings. Use an empty array when the command takes no parameters.
